convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 'BrakeExp' custom indicator (unknown implementation), plus external #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> library for order management. The custom indicator's buffer logic and the .mqh trading functions require manual Python reimplementation.

derived_values.name: UpTrend
derived_values.used_by: exit rule (close short if UpTrend active and no UpSignal)

derived_values.name: DnTrend
derived_values.used_by: exit rule (close long if DnTrend active and no DnSignal)

derived_values.name: UpSignal
derived_values.used_by: entry rule (long) and exit rule (close short)

derived_values.name: DnSignal
derived_values.used_by: entry rule (short) and exit rule (close long)

other_exits: Close short if UpTrend[0] is non-zero and no DnSignal (trend-based exit)
Close long if DnTrend[0] is non-zero and no UpSignal (trend-based exit)
Close short on UpSignal (signal reversal exit when SellPosClose=true)
Close long on DnSignal (signal reversal exit when BuyPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (abs value), positive values as deposit share fraction

custom_logic_notes: The BrakeExp custom indicator has 4 buffers: buffer0=UpTrend, buffer1=DnTrend, buffer2=UpSignal, buffer3=DnSignal. Entry signals require the signal buffer to be non-zero. Trend-based exits occur when the opposing trend buffer is non-zero but no signal buffer fires. Signal timestamps are tracked (UpSignalTime, DnSignalTime) and passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen - likely for bar-time validation in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. The Recount flag causes recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates that enable/disable respective trade actions.
external_dependencies: BrakeExp custom indicator (BrakeExp.ex5 or BrakeExp.mq5 required)
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement BrakeExp indicator logic in Python - need to locate and translate the BrakeExp.mq5 indicator source. The 4-buffer system (UpTrend/DnTrend/UpSignal/DnSignal) must be faithfully replicated. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory) need Python equivalents - these handle position checking, lot sizing from MM parameter, and new-bar detection. The MM=-0.1 convention (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. Signal timestamps used for trade validation must be understood from the .mqh source.
